title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: cargo-type premium uplifts and contract discount by tier
content:
## Scope

This matrix belongs to the Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims product line. It lists, for every tier, the premium uplift held for each special cargo category and the premium discount figures held for holders of a service contract.

## Uplift and discount matrix

| Tier | Uplift for dangerous goods cargo | Uplift for reefer cargo | Uplift for out-of-gauge cargo | Lowest qualifying service contract tier rank | Contract premium discount |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Carrier Liability | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 percent |
| AHL Declared Value Liability | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent | 0 | 0 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Essential | 0 percent | 0 percent | 10 percent | 3 | 10 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Plus | 0 percent | 20 percent | 10 percent | 3 | 10 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Premium | 25 percent | 15 percent | 10 percent | 3 | 15 percent |
| AHL CargoCare Total | 40 percent | 10 percent | 10 percent | 3 | 15 percent |

## Definitions

- **Uplift for dangerous goods, reefer or out-of-gauge cargo**: a premium uplift, in whole percent, held for a cover whose cargo is of that category.
- **Lowest qualifying service contract tier rank**: the lowest service contract tier rank whose holder gets the premium discount. A figure of 0 means the tier gives no discount.
- **Contract premium discount**: the premium discount, in whole percent, for qualifying contract holders.

## Points of judgement

**Can a holder of a service contract of any rank obtain the contract discount on AHL Standard Carrier Liability or AHL Declared Value Liability?**
No. Both tiers hold 0 as the lowest qualifying rank, and 0 means no discount.

**Is there a reefer uplift on AHL CargoCare Essential?**
The matrix holds 0 percent for reefer cargo on that tier.

**Which tier holds the largest dangerous goods uplift?**
AHL CargoCare Total, at 40 percent.
